episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her expertise on leveraging YouTube for lead generation and the importance of having a structured system for lead conversion. She emphasizes the use of Zoom consultations and exploratory trips to filter serious buyers and introduces the showing agent model as a solution for managing multiple clients. These insights are crucial for agents looking to scale their business and improve efficiency.
